# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

**Do not** open a public issue, discussion, or pull request for security vulnerabilities.

Instead, please use one of these private channels:

- **GitHub:** [Report via Private Vulnerability Reporting](https://github.com/acevedo-daniel/dms-demo/security/advisories/new)
- **Direct contact:** Contact the repository maintainer through their GitHub profile if private reporting is unavailable.

### What to include

- Affected component, route, or dependency and version
- Impact assessment
- Steps to reproduce or minimal proof of concept
- Known mitigations, if any

### Response timeline

| Step | Target |
| --- | --- |
| Acknowledgment | 48 hours |
| Initial assessment | 5 business days |
| Fix or mitigation | Best effort, communicated in the advisory |

## Supported versions

| Version | Status |
| --- | :---: |
| `main` | ✅ Supported |

## Scope

This policy covers the source code and configuration in this repository. Third-party dependencies should be reported to their respective maintainers.

## Demo data

This repository is a public portfolio demonstration and contains only fictional data. Do not submit real patient, client, clinical, authentication, or other sensitive information as part of a security report.

## Recognition

Contributors who responsibly disclose valid vulnerabilities will be acknowledged in the release notes or advisory unless they prefer to remain anonymous.
